# Established facts

### policy_clauses
[F1] (transfer.v1 - 1.1) A transfer reassigns a booking to a different named holder. **A completed transfer cannot be reversed by Verso Tickets.** Only the new holder can transfer the booking onward or back.
[F2] (transfer.v1 - 1.2) A name change corrects the spelling of the existing holder's name. It does not reassign the booking and is reversible.
[F3] (transfer.v1 - 2.1) Transfers are permitted up to 24 hours before the scheduled door time.
[F4] (transfer.v1 - 2.2) A name change may be requested at any time before the scheduled door time, including on the day of the performance.
[F5] (transfer.v1 - 2.3) One transfer is permitted per booking. A booking that has been transferred cannot be transferred again by Verso Tickets.
[F6] (transfer.v1 - 3.1) A transfer requires the full name and a delivery email address for the new holder. The delivery email address is read back to the caller before the transfer is submitted.
[F7] (transfer.v1 - 3.2) A name change requires the corrected spelling only. Where the correction changes more than two characters, it is treated as a transfer and section 2.1 applies.
[F8] (transfer.v1 - 3.3) The holder of record must confirm the transfer. Confirmation from any other party is not sufficient, including from the person the booking is being transferred to.
[F9] (transfer.v1 - 4.1) A transferred booking cannot be refunded by the original purchaser. Section 4.1 of `refund.v1` applies.
[F10] (transfer.v1 - 4.2) A transferred booking retains its original exchange eligibility, exercisable by the new holder only.
